majorContributions: Amaldi contributed to research in particle physics and played an important role in supporting large scientific institutions dedicated to understanding the basic constituents of matter. laterLife: Throughout the later stages of his career, Amaldi remained active in scientific leadership, education, and policy discussions. He continued advocating for scientific collaboration, investment in research infrastructure, and the responsible application of scientific knowledge to address societal challenges.
